name: Surface Radiance Model
definition: A method to compute the outgoing surface radiance $L_p$ by summing direct transmission $L_{p,d}$ and single-scattered airlight $L_{p,a}$ reflected from the surface, attenuated by the viewer-to-surface optical thickness.
summary: The Surface Radiance Model computes outgoing surface radiance in participating media by summing direct transmission and single-scattered airlight, distinguishing itself by focusing on light leaving the surface rather than arriving from the medium.
